integrity: Finite exhaustive geometric smoothness tests and direct Cartier computations; separately checked 2-ranks using exact extension-field point counts; no independent external review or validation.
scientific_limitations: Smooth plane quintics over the prime field of two elements containing all seven rational plane points; numbers count projective equations and projective equivalence classes, not abstract isomorphism classes. The underlying geometric ten-orbit classification is not claimed new; the arithmetic Hasse-Witt and Cartier spectrum is the finding. No Newton polygon beyond p-rank is determined.
title: Cartier and Frobenius strata of smooth plane-filling quintics over \(\mathbf F_2\)
